english.title: Remove / interfere with a penalty charge notice fixed to vehicle without authority
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) removed or interfered with a penalty charge notice fixed to a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), in accordance with regulation 9(2)(a) or (3) of the Civil Enforcement of Road Traffic Contraventions (Approved Devices, Charging Guidelines and General Provisions) (England) Regulations 2022, other than by or under the authority of the owner or person in charge of the vehicle or the enforcement authority
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 12 of the Civil Enforcement of Road Traffic Contraventions (Approved Devices, Charging Guidelines and General Provisions) (England) Regulations 2022.

english.notes: The penalty charge must be given in accordance with regulation 9(2)(a) or (3) whereby a parking contravention and a penalty charge is given by a civil enforcement officer.
